query: SELECT strftime(date_trunc('month', date), '%Y-%m') AS month, count(DISTINCT tx_hash) AS txs FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash, script_hash AS h FROM transaction_scripts WHERE date in <year window> UNION ALL SELECT date, tx_hash, owner_payment_credential AS h FROM address_utxo WHERE date >= DATE '2021-09-01' AND date < DATE '2022-01-01') WHERE h IN ('73990b71041ceade6f867617f6ce9f187ab710ea2bf1ff8db7d0292f', '1af84a9e697e1e7b042a0a06f061e88182feb9e9ada950b36a916bd5')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
